$comment: Hand-written notes for scripts/kb/gen-server-handbook.ts, Build 42.21 (revision 4a0e9546ec). Each note says what the code does with an option or command, in one line, and names the site it was read from (<class or Lua file>#<method or function>, one of the item's sites in server-surface-42.21.json, or 'declaration'). The generator refuses a note whose site is not one of the item's sites.

MaxPlayers.effect: `ServerOptions#getMaxPlayers` returns the smaller of this value and 254, a cap written into the code.

PingLimit.effect: 0 turns it off. Above 0, a player whose ping is higher than this value is kicked while loading, unless their role has `CantBeKickedIfTooLaggy`.

SaveWorldEveryMinutes.effect: 0 turns it off. Above 0, once this many real minutes have passed since the last save the server queues a full save, and runs it when no backup is in progress.

PauseEmpty.effect: On the server, the game counts as paused while no player is connected and this is true.

SpeedLimit.effect: On a multiplayer client the engine stops pushing a car forward once it reaches this speed in km/h. The speed anti-cheat also uses it as the limit for a player in a vehicle (`AntiCheatSpeed#validate`, 20 for a player on foot).

CarEngineAttractionModifier.effect: On the server, the loudness of the world sound a running engine makes is multiplied by this value.

PVPMeleeDamageModifier.effect: On the server, the damage of a melee weapon hit on a character's body is multiplied by this value. Before that, the damage is the weapon's random damage times 15 (times 4 more on the head or neck, 2 on the upper torso).

PVPFirearmDamageModifier.effect: On the server, the damage of a ranged weapon hit on a character's body is multiplied by this value. Before that, the damage is the weapon's random damage times 15 (times 4 more on the head or neck, 2 on the upper torso).

BadWordPolicy.effect: When the word filter flags a chat message, the server bans (1), kicks (2) or logs (3) the sender. The range is 1 to 3, so the "4 - mute" in the description cannot be set: a 4 in the file is refused and the value stays where it was.

WebhookAddress.effect: When it is not empty, the server starts a `StackBot` with this address at start-up. It is not one of the options kept off the public list, so its value is written to every joining player along with the other public options.

ItemNumbersLimitPerContainer.effect: 0 turns it off. Above 0, a multiplayer client shows the item count against the limit under a container, and the transfer action counts the destination's items against it (`ISInventoryTransferAction:isValid`); containers on a character are left out. All its read sites are client Lua.

FastForwardMultiplier.effect: While the server is fast-forwarding, `GameTime#getMultiplier` uses this value divided by the length of a day in minutes.

SafehouseDaySurvivedToClaim.effect: 0 turns it off. Above 0, a player who has survived fewer than this many days (hours survived below the value times 24) cannot claim a safehouse.

FactionDaySurvivedToCreate.effect: 0 turns it off. Otherwise a player needs at least this many days survived (hours survived of at least the value times 24) to create a faction.

MaxAccountsPerUser.effect: 0 or less turns it off, and so does a server not running in Steam mode. Otherwise the server counts the other accounts that use the same SteamID before it allows a new one.

SafeHouseRemovalTime.effect: A number of hours: the code multiplies it by 3,600,000 milliseconds. 0 turns removal off; otherwise `SafeHouse#update` releases every safehouse that `isSafeHouseExpired` reports as expired and tells every player.

BloodSplatLifespanDays.effect: This server option is read nowhere. The sandbox option with the same name, `BloodSplatLifespanDays`, is the one `IsoChunk` and `IsoObject` read.

ZombieRespawn.effect: No game code reads it. Choosing a value on the server settings screen fills in three advanced values: `ZombieConfig.RespawnHours` 16, 72, 216 or 0, `ZombieConfig.RespawnUnseenHours` 6, 16, 48 or 0, and `ZombieConfig.RespawnMultiplier` 0.5, 0.1, 0.05 or 0 (for High, Normal, Low and None). Those three are what the game reads.

ZombieMigrate.effect: No game code reads it. Ticking it on the server settings screen sets `ZombieConfig.RedistributeHours` to 12.0, unticking it sets 0.0; the game reads that value.

DayLength.effect: Real minutes per in-game day: choice 1 is 15, 2 is 30, 3 is 60, 4 is 90, and from 5 up it is (choice minus 3) times 60.

RuralLooted.effect: On a square outside every town region, the looted chance is multiplied by this value after it is cut to a whole number: anything below 1.0 gives 0 (the chance then becomes its floor of 1), 1.0 to 1.99 leaves it unchanged, 2.0 doubles it. The diminished-loot percentage (`getCurrentDiminishedLootPercentage`) is cut the same way, and there below 1.0 means none.

MaximumLooted.effect: The looted chance grows with the days since the world began: this value times the days, divided by `DaysUntilMaximumLooted`, with the days capped at that number. 0 turns it off, and a `DaysUntilMaximumLooted` of 0 gives the full value from the first day. A "Rich" square gets 1.5 times, and the result is at least 1.

MultiplierConfig.GlobalToggle.effect: In `IsoGameCharacter.XP#AddXP`, when this is true the XP gain is multiplied by `MultiplierConfig.Global`; when it is false, by the skill's own `MultiplierConfig.<skill>` value.

MultiplierConfig.Global.effect: Multiplies the XP gain in `IsoGameCharacter.XP#AddXP` while `MultiplierConfig.GlobalToggle` is true. The per-skill values are used only when it is false.

HoursForCorpseRemoval.effect: 0 or less: the corpse pass does nothing. Otherwise each rot stage of a human corpse lasts a third of this many hours, and of an animal corpse a quarter. The pass runs everywhere except on a multiplayer client.

DaysForRottenFoodRemoval.effect: -1 turns it off. From 0 up, rotten food is destroyed once its age passes the age at which it rots (`OffAgeMax`) by this many days, unless it sits in a compost bin.

NatureAbundance.effect: Foraging reads it through a variable: `forageSystem.getRefillBonus` looks up `SandboxVars[abundanceSetting]`, and the forage zones and definitions set `abundanceSetting` to "NatureAbundance" (it is also the fallback). The refill bonus is 1 plus one hundredth of the matching entry in `forageSystem.abundanceSettings`.

Farming.effect: Not read: the only `SandboxVars.Farming` lines, in `media/lua/server/Farming/farming_vegetableconf.lua`, are commented out. Every "Farming" listed above is the skill, a loot type or a crafting category, not this option.

Map.AllowMiniMap.effect: The minimap is allowed only when the world map is allowed and this is true. The default is false, so a server that keeps the defaults has no minimap: see [the missing minimap](/pz/build-42/modding/multiplayer/missing-minimap-check-the-sandbox-first).

additem.effect: A count above 100 is lowered to 100 (the server prints "Cannot spawn over 100 items at a time").

createhorde.effect: The count is capped at 500. Each zombie is placed on a random square up to 10 tiles from the player on each axis, on the player's floor, and the horde is written to the admin log.

changeoption.effect: Saves the ini file at once. Changing `Password` also sets the server's password, changing `ClientCommandFilter` reloads the filter, and on a Steam server the Steam settings are applied again. Every change is written to the admin log.

stats.effect: `/stats list` lists the statistics, `/stats version` prints the game version, `/stats <statistic> list` lists its counters, `/stats <statistic> all` prints every value and `/stats <statistic> <counter>` one value. Anything else, `/stats help` included, prints the help text again.
